claims.text: Gaza value added averaged ~$670m a quarter in the three years before the war (UNCTAD) — about $2.7bn a year; Q1 2024 activity 86% below pre-war; Palestine per-capita GDP ~$3,800.
PCBS: Gaza real GDP 2025 down 84% vs 2023; Gaza unemployment 78% in 2025.
SIPRI: Israel military expenditure $46.5bn in 2024, up 65%, 8.8% of GDP, 12th in world.
IISS: IDF 169,500 active, 465,000 reservists; 316 combat aircraft; 5 submarines; SIPRI: ~90 nuclear warheads.
Costs of War/Quincy: at least $21.7bn US military aid to Israel 7 Oct 2023–Sep 2025 ($17.9bn first year, $3.8bn second); plus $9.65–12bn US regional operations.
SIPRI: US 69% and Germany 30% of Israel's arms imports (2023).
INSS: at war's start Hamas had ~18,000–30,000 rockets and inaccurate missiles; ~20,000–25,000 combatants; tunnels ~500–700 km; Kornet anti-tank missiles; drones.

Hamas finances: military budget $100–350m a year (Israeli and Palestinian sources); taxes and fees up to $300–450m (Levitt); Iran ~$100m a year (State Dept); Qatar $1.49bn civilian aid 2012–21; $500m investment portfolio (US Treasury); crypto small; Hamas says civil and military funds separate.
MOU signed 14 Sep 2016: $38bn over FY2019–2028; $3.3bn FMF plus $500m missile defense a year.
